summary: Short practical follow-up sequence built from the audit context for The Horseshoe.

steps.subject: The Horseshoe: quick website note
steps.body: Wanted to send over a quick follow-up. I took a look at The Horseshoe and noticed meta description and h1 heading. Nothing catastrophic — just a few things that can make the business feel harder to trust or contact online. If helpful, I can send the short version with the first 2–3 fixes I’d make.

steps.subject: Following up in case this got buried
steps.body: Just bumping this once in case it got buried. The main reason I reached out is that these are very fixable issues, and they usually do not require a giant rebuild to improve. If you want, I can keep it simple and just send the biggest quick wins.

steps.subject: The Horseshoe: the fast version
steps.body: Boiled down: tighten the trust signals, make the next step more obvious, and clean up the weak spots around meta description and h1 heading. That usually gets the site feeling a lot more current without turning it into a giant project.

steps.subject: Close the loop?
steps.body: Last nudge from me on this. If website cleanup is not a priority right now, no worries. If it is, reply and I can turn what I found into a simple action plan instead of a long complicated project.
